title: SAP HANA MM Functional Consultant (SE)

Job Qualifications:** * Extensive experience as an SAP MM Functional consultant. * Strong understanding of Cloud Computing principles and their application within SAP environments. * Proven expertise in ERP Integrations. * Solid knowledge of SAP Architecture. * In-depth SAP Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) expertise. * Comprehensive SAP Knowledge across various modules. * Familiarity with SAP MM,SD, FI Module and SAP PP (Production Planning). * Demonstrated experience in SAP Project Implementation. * Proficiency with SAP S/4HANA. * Familiarity with SAPUI5 for custom development. * Experience in Software Development and Software Support. * Understanding of System Administration principles. * Proficiency in Version Control systems.
